notes.title: Urgent announcement about Mac OSx Catalina Update
notes.notes:
Today I got an email which mentioned that people who has played the game with the non notarized version got a trouble to play the notarized version, so I decided to reverted all the apps which I has updated to support Catalina to the previous version while I'll try to find out the solution. 

Only East Tower series are still at 32 bit which won't work with Catalina, so I will build a non notarized 64 bit version first to settle the issue first.
I already tested but the non notarized 64 bit version apps are still working fine with Catalina, so that should be fine for the temporary solution.

Beside this, I also noticed the earlier build of CAFE 0 Mermaid achievements are not triggered on Mac. This will also get my priority too. Hopefully I can update everything until tomorrow.
I'm very sorry for the inconvenience.

Sincerely,
Chu-3/Roseverte

notes.title: How to Take Off Your Mask major update v2.0!
notes.notes:
I have updated How to Take Off Your Mask games on Steam for English, German, and Japanese version. The update for the demo will follow soon.
This updates shouldn't affect your save data.

You should get these updates automatically.

The Changes
1. Button’s Sound Effect

Many people told me that HTTOYM Button sounds is very loud and bothering, which I assume happened because of the high frequency of the sound. This has been fixed in HTFALK, and the same changes will be applied to HTTOYM.

2. GUI

HTTOYM GUI will be updated with HTFALK GUI design, and make the quick save/load features enabled.

The GUI until now:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9234571/9ae7527d12dd349312100dbb65e36f3174b9dd36.jpg
The new GUI:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9234571/e22f29f5b1c06ba5ef44fbe0bc99dfce388677b6.jpg

Beside the Menu button at the bottom part of the text box, you can also access the menu using the right click button.

ATTENTION: This fix will be applied automatically if you start a new game, but you won’t see this gui fix immediately if you’re using an old save data. To use this fix with an old save data, please finish a chapter, choose to not continue the story, return back to the Title Screen (Don’t simple return to the chapter selection, since this fix is applied inside the title screen’s code), then go to start and choose the next chapter you’re going to continue with (without using the load menu).

3. New Shortcut Keys

You can now also use the A key for Auto Forward, P for Skip (old: only Ctrl for force skipping all text, and skip button inside menu), and Esc for Menu.

4. Right click menu is now enabled during the choice.

In the old version, enabling a right click menu during the choices will cause bigger issue, but somehow I found a workaround to solve this. Now you can access the menu easily by using right click (old version is menu button only) and also you can choose to use quick save to save the game easier.

Thank you for keep supporting the project :)

notes.title: Spanish version is now available!
notes.notes:
Spanish version of "How to Take Off Your Mask" is now available on Steam.
Thank you  to José Sierra for the translating help!ːleeaːːliliaː
The translation is based on the Latin America Spanish.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9234571/f0a28e070d06c74f422878214e7aa827baed1aea.jpg

If you're more comfortable with English and want to switch languages, please remember you can switch it from the game's property on Steam.

How to change the language:
1. Right click the title from your steam library, choose properties.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9234571/38a9a1c763fe4a47017d9a8c81d73c8bdc0b96e7.jpg

2. Go to language tab and choose the language you want.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9234571/3f5a9d181b38ccd7531f34f6dc83bba8379899a4.png

The game will download several additional datas before you can play with the language you want. Remember that the save data can't be used in other language version.

notes.title: Updated English version with adjusted BGM and Button SFX
notes.notes:
Since some people complains about the BGM and button's sfx loudness, I decided to update it with a new patch, with the volume reduced -3dB.

This issue is actually caused by the player's side speaker spec so it's hard to adjust it from my side. 

Please let me know if it should be more quiet or loud later, so that I can adjust it better.

For people who prefer the previous BGM loudness, please change it through config>sound setting>BGM volume> change 2 to 3

notes.title: Android Version Released!　アンドロイド版をリリースしました
notes.notes:
English version: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.net.roseverte.httoym.en
日本語版: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.net.roseverte.anahazu.ja

Required:1-2GB RAM with around 200MB free space.

These are free apps with in app purchase.

Difference with PC ver:
Only 1 movie available (OP Movie), PV and bonus karaoke movie is removed. Also images and audio's quality are adjusted to fit the mobile app size.
---

アプリ内課金付きのフリーアプリとなっております。
必要なスペック：1-2GBRAMと200MBほどの空き容量

PC版との違い：
動画はOPムービーしか入っておりません。PVとカラオケ版ボーナスが削除され、また画像とオーディオファイルの質もモバイル容量に合わせるため微調整しました。
